decisions.reason: The lantern sighting over the Harbour of Nowhere and the vault dug under Mount Fictus are different events in different places and years.
Both are about the 1958 light over the Harbour of Nowhere; the harbour log says it was a flare from the pilot boat, where Bo Fixture says a green lantern rose out of the water.
decisions.difference: An official record that explains the light as a flare fired at ten past nine, not a craft.

decisions.reason: A general theory about what the lanterns are, beside the specific 1958 sighting it comments on.
Both tell of the vault dug under Mount Fictus in 1971 holding things not from here; Bo Fixture relays it from Cy Fixture, who here tells it himself.
decisions.difference: First hand from a member of the digging crew, who speaks of crates carried in rather than of what was kept.
